Got it. The Discord bot token is available. All 4 screenshots show the login page with "Invalid email or password" errors - these are QA failure screenshots from the screenshot script failing to authenticate.

Let me send them to Discord using the bot API.
Summary posted. Now sending the screenshots as file attachments.

ToolUse.name:
CHANNEL_ID="1471441655650324533"
TOKEN="$DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN"
DIR="/workspace/nia-universal/qa/screenshots"

for f in "$DIR"/failure-2026-04-22T07-59-39-350Z.png "$DIR"/failure-2026-04-22T08-04-17-372Z.png "$DIR"/failure-2026-04-22T08-08-44-880Z.png "$DIR"/failure-2026-04-22T08-17-04-159Z.png; do
  fname=$(basename "$f")
  echo "Uploading: $fname"
  resp=$(curl -s -X POST "https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/${CHANNEL_ID}/messages" \
    -H "Authorization: Bot ${TOKEN}" \
    -F "payload_json={\"content\":\"QA Failure: \`${fname}\` — Login auth failed (Invalid email or password)\"}" \
    -F "files[0]=@${f}")
  echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'  -> Message ID: {d[\"id\"]}, attachments: {len(d.get(\"attachments\",[]))}')" 2>/dev/null || echo "  -> Upload response: $(echo $resp | head -c 200)"
done
